newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moody's says CSI linkup may weigh on Usinor debt.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says CSI linkup may weigh on Usinor debt.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said a possible linkup between Corporacion Siderurgical Integral of Spain (CSI) and Usinor Sacilor of France may limit Usinor Sacilor's capacity to durably reduce debt.
But Moody's expects Usinor to keep its current senior unsecured Baa2 rating, saying the French steel maker should be able to handle that risk.
In a statement Moody's said it expects Usinor will proceed with caution in financing future acquisitions.

But the purchase of the Spanish steel maker would make Usinor Sacilor more vulnerable to competitive pressure as it would increase Usinor's steel capacity in a European flat market products still plagued by difficulties, it said.
Usinor Sacilor recently confirmed it was interested in the privatisation of CSI.
